disciplines_applied.assessment: The ledger is mostly quiet (0.0% decisive). I do not mistake exchange housekeeping for economic flow, and I do not narrate silence.

Flow is defined by its window and watchlist — 24h and 7d reference points against per-cycle snapshots. Change the window and the number changes, so the window is part of the result. Flow accounting is an identity, not a model.
No edge to explain — I will not invent a microstructure story for a statistic that is not there.

Exchange wallets are hubs with unmistakable degree signatures; I separate hub-to-periphery economic movement from hub-to-hub internal plumbing. One edge is an anecdote; a pattern of edges is evidence.
decisive_frac=0.0% over n=91; scoreboard still warming up (n=156/200). Whale events are rare — I size my claims to my sample.
When in doubt I vote HOLD: adopting noise corrupts every forecast it touches, and that is the costliest error I can make.
Pipeline healthy: ledger reachable 96.7% of cycles; watchlist labels verified, never guessed; same ledger state reproduces the same numbers.

A whale alert is not a trade signal — by the time a 10M XRP transfer confirms on-ledger, the market has often already priced it. The edge, if any, is in quiet accumulation, not the splash. That is why no APPLY verdict of mine ever skips out-of-sample proof.
Known: 0.0% decisive reads over 91 cycles, 0 whale-pulse cycles. Unknown: whether whales change behavior once watched. Confidence: low — the honest answer.
Hypothesis ledger updated — statuses changed only where the evidence moved them; nothing was buried and nothing was accepted without a test.
